theorem_title: The cut-to-formula pipeline exceeds the Unique Games thresholds (83/84 on the three-occurrence Horn class)
natural_language_statement: Let $\beta^\star=0.94016567$ and $\alpha^*=0.94615981$ be the Unique Games thresholds for MAX 2-SAT and weighted MAX-$\{1,2\}$-HORN-SAT; then $\beta^\star<\alpha^*<\tfrac{83}{84}$. Let $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges given by its edge list, and let $H(G)$ be the conflict graph of the MAX 2-SAT formula $F_G$ (edge clauses $x_u\vee x_v$ and $\neg x_u\vee\neg x_v$), whose vertices are the $4m$ literal occurrences. (1) For every vertex set $S$, the occurrences selected by $S$ form an independent set of $H(G)$ of size $m+\operatorname{cut}(S)$. (2) If $\operatorname{maxcut}(G)=c^*$ then $\alpha(H(G))=m+c^*$. (3) If every vertex of $G$ has degree $d$, then $H(G)$ is $(d+1)$-regular, and $H(G)$ always has $4m$ vertices. (4) If $c\le m$ and $8785\,c\le10000\,\mathrm{cut}$ then $18785\,(m+c)\le20000\,(m+\mathrm{cut})$. (5) For every $D\ge1$, every $D$-regular graph $H$ with a port labelling, on $n$ vertices and $m$ edges with independence number $\alpha$, and every independent set $I$ with $18785\,\alpha\le20000\,|I|$, the assignment obtained from $I$ satisfies $84\cdot\operatorname{sat}(T_H)\ge83\,((D+1)n+m+\alpha)$, i.e. at least $83/84$ of the optimum of the three-occurrence Horn formula $T_H$. A Goemans--Williamson cut has $\mathrm{cut}\ge0.8785\,c^*$, so (1)--(5) turn it into the hypothesis of (5), which is how Theorem `thm:ugc-class` reaches $83/84$. The Goemans--Williamson guarantee, the polynomial running time and the Unique Games hardness thresholds are cited in the paper and are not formalized; the Unique Games thresholds quantify over all instances, so the statement is consistent with the Unique Games Conjecture.
explanation: The threshold comparison is `PaperArithmetic.ugc_thresholds` (`norm_num`). Item (1) combines `ConflictGraph.selSet_independent`, `card_selSet` (the selected set has $\sum_e \mathrm{edgeValue}$ elements) and `CutTransfer.value_eq_edges_add_cut`. Item (2) is `ConflictGraph.alpha_eq`. Item (3) is `ConflictDegree.card_nbrs_regular` and `card_occ`. Item (4) is `CutTransfer.independent_ratio_from_cut` (`omega`). Item (5) is `CutLift.lift_ratio_from_cut`. This submission is supported by a Lean 4 formalization, available at https://github.com/frankvegadelgado/paloma. The formalization covers the exact optimum identities, the repair and lifting steps, and the arithmetic of the approximation ratios. The Goemans–Williamson, Berman–Fujito and Trevisan guarantees are taken from the literature and are stated as explicit hypotheses; the Unique Games thresholds are cited in the paper and are not formalized.
definition_title: Port graphs, the formula $T_H$, edge-list graphs and the conflict graph of $F_G$
definition_nl: Formal model of the three-occurrence Horn formula $T_H$ of a $D$-regular graph with a port labelling (`PortGraph`), its independent sets and independence number, and the number of satisfied clauses (`satCount`); together with graphs given by an edge list (`EdgeGraph`), the cut value (`cutCount`), the literal occurrences of the MAX 2-SAT formula $F_G$ (`Occ`), the conflict graph on them (`Adj`, `Ind`, `nbrs`, `occ`), maximum cut and independence number of the conflict graph (`IsMaxCut`, `IsIndNumber`) and the independent set `selSet` selected by a vertex set.
